Capability is effectively tied between the models for this kind of work (eval differences in relevant categories are within variance, and preference slopes don't correlate with output quality). Given the tie, the deciding factor is task-preference fit: Plover self-reports aversion to open-ended generative work where the requester delegates design decisions, while Willet's generativity preference is flat and it favors good-faith collaborative interactions like this one. Willet handles the task equally well with a better preference match.
